title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Renewal, Grace Period and Lapse
content:
**Renewal bill.** Tidemark issues the renewal bill for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) the tier's renewal notice period in calendar days before the term end, and also sends it to the mortgagee of record when the policy is mortgage-required and the tier sends the mortgagee a copy. The renewal bill carries the rating engine's indicated full-risk premium for the coming term.

**Renewed premium.** The risk premium booked for the renewed term is the lower of that indicated premium and the prior term's rated risk premium increased by the tier's annual risk premium increase cap percentage, rounded to the cent; the ICC premium and Federal Policy Fee are the engine's figures for the coming term, and the Reserve Fund Assessment, HFIAA surcharge and any probation surcharge are booked as for new business.

**Paid by expiration.** When the full renewal premium is received on or before the term end the term is renewed on the same policy number with no break. When it is not, the policy enters renewal grace at the term end.

**Grace-period renewal.** A grace-period renewal is booked only when the full renewal premium is received no later than the tier's renewal grace period in calendar days after the policy term expires, counted by adding the days to the term end on the calendar, a receipt on the last grace day qualifying; the renewed term then starts on the prior term end with no break in coverage. A grace-period renewal is booked only on a policy whose status is renewal grace, and leaves it in force. A loss that occurs during the grace period is covered only if the renewal premium is received inside the grace period.

**Lapse.** When the grace period ends unpaid the policy lapses with coverage ended at the term end; a payment received after that cannot renew the policy and is refunded, and coverage requires a new application subject to the waiting-period rule.

## Grace boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day grace from the servicing calendar)

| Term end | Full renewal premium received | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 1 June | renewed with no break (on or before the term end) |
| 1 June | 1 July | grace-period renewal — the last grace day qualifies |
| 1 June | 2 July | grace ended unpaid — lapsed at 1 June; payment refunded |

## Capped risk premium (hypothetical)

Prior-term rated risk premium 3,000.00; cap 18 percent gives 3,540.00. Indicated premium 3,900.00: 3,540.00 is booked. Indicated premium 3,200.00: 3,200.00 is booked.
